message: Rakesh consistently demonstrates deep understanding of network security concepts. His projects go beyond academic requirements - GhostNet is genuinely impressive work for a student.
Best person to have on your team for reverse engineering and forensics challenges. Always calm under pressure during competitions, and his automation scripts save us hours.
His ability to bridge security and creative development is rare. The KALP_AI project showed me that pentesting tools can actually have a beautiful UI. Plus he types at 80+ WPM.
Integrating SHAP explainability into threat hunting was a novel approach. SentinelHunt is well-structured research that could be extended into a published paper with more data.
